name: ClaraConverts – Your Website Employee
author: Volker Arndt

sections.description:
Clara is your website employee — not another chatbot.

Most website chatbots sit in the corner and wait. Clara works. She understands what your business sells, starts the conversation before a visitor slips away, answers out loud in a natural voice and in the visitor’s own language, qualifies the visitor, books the appointment, and turns anonymous traffic into named customers — 24 hours a day, while you sleep.

Why Clara, not a generic AI chatbot?

A generic chatbot answers when it’s spoken to. Clara sells. She reads your entire site so she knows your business cold, greets every visitor with a reason to stay, listens and adapts, and drives each conversation toward a booking, a lead, or a sale. And she’s the only website AI that actually talks back — replying out loud in a natural human voice, so the visitors who’d rather listen than read stay engaged.

See her in action: Clara is greeting visitors on our own homepage right now — say hello at https://claraconverts.com

What Clara does for you

  • Starts conversations automatically so visitors don’t leave without asking a single question.
  • Greets every visitor in their own language — Clara speaks nine and detects each visitor’s automatically, so an international audience feels at home.
  • Turns anonymous visitors into named prospects — Clara qualifies interest and captures the lead, even while you sleep.
  • Talks back out loud — Clara speaks every reply in a natural human voice, in real time. No other site chatbot does this.
  • Books appointments, reservations, and stays right inside the chat.
  • Recommends products and builds the cart so browsers become buyers.
  • Knows your whole business — Clara reads your entire site, not just the homepage, so every answer is accurate and on-brand.
  • Routes every lead straight to your CRM and email list, so nothing slips through the cracks.

Live in 30 seconds. No code.

Install the free plugin, click Connect, and Clara reads your site and goes live on your pages within seconds. No API keys. No copy-paste. No developer. If you ever cancel, the widget removes itself automatically.

Who it’s for

  • Small businesses that want a 24/7 employee without adding headcount.
  • Sites that get real visitor traffic but let too much of it leave without converting.
  • Businesses with an international audience who want every visitor greeted in their own language.
  • Agencies and freelancers who want to add conversion AI to client sites without writing code. (Agency white-label is available at claraconverts.com/agencies, not through this plugin.)

Pricing

The plugin is free. Clara runs on Clara Cloud, a paid subscription:

  • Standard — $49/mo — Clara answers, qualifies, and captures leads in text.
  • Pro — $99/mo — Everything in Standard, plus voice: Clara speaks every reply out loud. Recommended.
  • Volume — $799/mo — Up to 10 sites on one subscription, every Pro feature on every site.

Cancel within 14 days for a full refund — no questions asked. Cancel anytime after that from your billing portal.

External services

This plugin connects to the following external service to provide its functionality:

Clara Cloud (ClaraConverts) — https://claraconverts.com

The plugin sends the following data to Clara Cloud:

  • Your site URL (during the install handshake, so Clara can read your site)
  • The site admin email address (used to bind your Clara Cloud subscription to your site)
  • A site identifier derived from your blog ID and home URL host (used to track which sites are connected)
  • Visitor conversations (only after you subscribe — visitor messages are sent to Clara Cloud for processing)
  • Lead capture data (name, email, message — only when a visitor fills out a lead form in the chat)

Terms of use: https://claraconverts.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://claraconverts.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin. Pick claraconverts-website-employee.zip and click Install Now.
  2. Click Activate.
  3. Open Settings → ClaraConverts. Clara reads your site and shows you a live preview of herself on it.
  4. Choose your plan. Clara goes live on your site within seconds.

Or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory: search for “ClaraConverts – Your Website Employee” under Plugins → Add New.
sections.faq:
How is Clara different from a normal chatbot?

A normal chatbot waits to be asked a question and reads back an answer. Clara starts the conversation, understands what your business sells, qualifies the visitor, books appointments, recommends products, and speaks her replies out loud in a natural voice. She’s built to turn visitors into customers, not just to deflect support tickets.

What languages does Clara speak?

Nine, with natural voices — English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Japanese, and Chinese. In auto mode she detects each visitor’s language and replies in it, so one install can greet an international audience. You can also pin her to a single language.

Do I need to write or paste any code?

No. The plugin handles everything. Subscribe inside the plugin and the widget mounts itself.

Is the plugin free?

Yes — the WordPress plugin is free and always will be. Clara herself runs on Clara Cloud, a paid subscription that starts at $49/mo with a 14-day money-back guarantee.

What happens if I cancel?

The widget disappears from your site automatically. The plugin stays installed and shows the preview again, so you can resubscribe anytime.

Will Clara slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously after your page renders, so it never blocks paint or interactivity. Conversation traffic goes to Clara Cloud, not your server.

Where does my visitors’ data go?

Conversations are processed by Clara Cloud. Read the full privacy policy at https://claraconverts.com/privacy.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Refreshed listing to reflect what Clara does today: nine-language voice conversations with automatic visitor-language detection, appointment booking, product recommendations, and lead routing. These run on Clara Cloud and are live for connected sites — no plugin action required.

1.1.0

  • New preview experience — instead of a small admin card, the plugin now opens a full-viewport preview on claraconverts.com showing your site with Clara floating on top.
  • “Open preview” button opens in a new browser tab; “Continue to choose a plan” returns you to wp-admin.
  • Reports your site’s timezone during setup so lead and chat times display in your local zone.

1.0.1

  • Bumped “Tested up to” to WordPress 7.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Live in-admin Clara preview before subscription.
  • One-click checkout with auto-configuration after payment.
  • Reconnect flow for plugin reinstalls and domain migrations.
  • Public-site widget injection via wp_footer.
